title: Designing Photoreal Environments for Cinematics
description: In this course from Epic Online Learning, we cover the full range of techniques you need to create large scale cityscapes. Kitbash together existing high-quality assets to create a coherent theme. Learn how to use the Foliage Tool to build up your environment and create a Master Material for more versatility in lighting and color schemes. Populate a city with static signs and animated objects, then composite live-action videos into the scene using the Unreal Engine's Media Player pipeline.
